name: Advanced Product Condition Manager
author: Md Siddiqur Rahman

sections.description:
Advanced Product Condition Manager allows you to specify the condition of products in your WooCommerce store. Whether you’re selling new, used, or refurbished items, this plugin helps you clearly communicate the product’s condition to your customers.

Key Features

  • Add condition status to products (New, Used, Refurbished)
  • Display product condition on product pages
  • Customizable condition labels
  • Filter products by condition
  • Compatible with WooCommerce product types
  • Clean and lightweight implementation
  • Easy to set up and use

Perfect For

  • Marketplaces selling both new and used items
  • Electronics stores offering refurbished products
  • Antique and vintage shops
  • Any store that needs to specify product conditions
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/apcfw-product-condition-manager directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the WooCommerce > Settings > Products > Product Condition screen to configure the plugin
  4. Begin adding condition status to your products from the product edit page
sections.faq:
Does this work with all WooCommerce product types?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with all WooCommerce product types including simple, variable, grouped, and external products.

Will this affect my existing products?

No, installing the plugin will not change any of your existing products. You’ll need to manually set the condition for each product as needed.

Can I display the condition on shop/archive pages?

Yes, the condition status can be displayed on both product and shop/archive pages.

Is it compatible with my theme?

The plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme. If you experience any styling issues, please contact our support.
